transcript: Hi Ava! Are you ready to become a scientist and explore how things change? Look at these items on the counter! We have a solid ice cube, a glass of liquid water, and a steaming kettle. Everything is made of matter, but they all look and feel very different. Can you see the tiny bubbles in the steam? What happens if we add heat to our solid ice? It starts to wiggle and flow! Matter can change its state when we change the temperature. Let's use our tools to see if we can turn this solid into a liquid together. Now it is your turn to predict what happens next in our experiment!
